headline: Liverpool 3-1 Tottenham: Szoboszlai from distance, Spurs still without a win
whyCareReason: Mac Allister, Gakpo, then a stoppage-time rocket. Gallagher scored Spurs' first against a top-flight side this season. It was not enough.
teaser: FINAL: Liverpool 3-1 Tottenham. Mac Allister 21', Gakpo 54', Gallagher 69', Szoboszlai 90+1'.
story:
Why this one matters: Tottenham had two league points and no league goals. Tuesday at Anfield was supposed to be a cup reset. It became 3-1 and another exit.

Sky: Alexis Mac Allister 21', first-time into the roof of the net. Cody Gakpo 54'. Conor Gallagher 69' from a corner, Tottenham's first goal against top-flight opposition this season. Dominik Szoboszlai 90+1' from distance. Giorgi Mamardashvili denied Lucas Bergvall early and Omar Marmoush late.

The Independent: Andoni Iraola made ten changes and still went through. Roberto De Zerbi called the result unfair. Spurs named a strong side and still have no win in 2026/27.
stakes: Liverpool in the last 16. Tottenham out of one of three remaining competitions, still winless.
rivalryAngle: A cup tie between two league underachievers. Only one of them can still use the League Cup as a season.
